import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
W=str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py')
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',W,n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
a=json.loads(Path('literal-bindings.json').read_text());assert len(a)==20
for i,v in a.items():
 b=Path('originals/'+i+'.jsonl').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==v['raw_sha256'];assert json.loads(b)==v['object'];assert json.loads(v['statement_token'])==v['object']['statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(v['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['statement_token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(v['object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==v['decoded_statement_sha256']
assert set(json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()))==set(a)
prev='0'*64;attempt=[]
for j,line in enumerate(Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 r=json.loads(line);assert r['seq']==j and r['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest()
 if r['event']=='attempt':attempt.append(r)
charges=[json.loads(s) for s in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==3;assert budget['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
for ch in charges:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(ch['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==ch['plan_sha256']
access=json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text());assert not any('cubical-zigzag-source-review-sol-r1' in x['path'] or 'expanded-corpus-r489' in x['path'] for x in access)
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'file':str(p),'exit':r['exit'],'killed':r['killed'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'affinity':r['affinity']})
write('RESOURCE-INVENTORY.json',json.dumps({'completed_receipts_before_terminal_audit':receipts,'limitations':'This inventory precedes its own receipt and final manifest receipt; both are preserved separately. Runner samples group RSS, may miss transients. Native tool telemetry and writer separate peak unavailable. All child jobs synchronous; no background jobs. No universal cgroup or host process compliance claim.'},indent=2))
write('DOCUMENTARY-AUDIT.json',json.dumps({'20_raw_token_decoded_bindings_verified':True,'20_gate_keys_verified':True,'guard_hashchain_verified':True,'get_attempts':len(attempt),'search_continuity':'3calls9queries verified','history_access_count':len(access),'new_peer_no_access_in_saved_inventory':True,'scientific_acceptance':False},indent=2))
print('documentary checks passed; no mathematics certified')
print(Path('verify_frozen.py').read_text()[-1800:])
